label: Appliances: Tumbler & Waschmaschine
info:
State machine for tumbler/dryer and washing machine. Publishes appliance states to MQTT for the dashboard.

Environment variables (set on this tab):
- TUMBLER_RUNNING_W: power threshold for 'running' (default 300)
- TUMBLER_FINISHING_W: power threshold for 'finishing' (default 50)
- TUMBLER_IDLE_W: power threshold for 'idle' (default 5)
- TUMBLER_FINISHING_MIN: minutes before 'finishing' transitions to 'done' (default 12)
- APPLIANCE_PANELS: comma-separated panel IDs (default kitchen)
